data.explanation: This is an appointment confirmation from an eye clinic for an examination that requires dilating your pupils. Because you won't be able to drive safely for a few hours afterwards, arrange for someone to accompany you or take public transport. Bring your glasses and a current list of your medications. No payment or legal deadline is involved here, so simply attend the appointment on time; if you can't make it, contact the clinic to reschedule.
